subject: executor: Use fakeSel to avoid memory allocate when chunk has no `sel` field in hash join v2 (#63732)
summary:
Diff vs parent (71caddf56d9c1887650568101590417558149e3f) only: adds package-level immutable `fakeSel` (len=4096) initialized once, and switches `baseJoinProbe.SetChunkForProbe` + `rowTableBuilder.ResetBuffer` to use `fakeSel[:logicalRows]` when `chk.Sel()==nil` to avoid per-chunk allocation/fill; otherwise allocates and fills a per-call slice.

Checked for correctness/concurrency hazards: `fakeSel` is only written in `init()` and thereafter treated read-only; `usedRows/selRows` are only read by probe/build code and `codec.SerializeKeys` (no mutation). No SQL semantics, transaction/session, or data-consistency behavior changes observed.

Later history up to `upstream/master`: no follow-up commits touching `fakeSel` usage (no `-S fakeSel` hits), suggesting no later bugfix was needed for this change.
